literal: Knowing the value of self-control, greatness it will yield, if, knowing wisdom, one is able to remain restrained in that path.
translation: If one acquires wisdom and remains self-controlled in that path, that restraint, being recognized, will bring them great excellence.
modern: அறிய வேண்டியவற்றை அறிந்து, நல்வழியில் அடங்கி வாழப் பெற்றால், அந்த அடக்கமானது அவனுக்குப் பெருமையைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights how self-control leads to true greatness when guided by wisdom. The poet states that if a person acquires proper knowledge and uses it to walk in the path of self-restraint, that restraint itself becomes a source of great dignity. The word 'cerivu' refers to the firmness of self-control, which yields excellence when practiced knowingly. Thus, true self-control is not passive, but an active, wise choice of conducting oneself in the right path.
